verdict.rationale: The IP practice page covers "patented and unpatented technology," which implies know-how and trade-secret-type work. The Employment page cites individual employee disputes, investigations and employee retention, and the TMT page mentions "protection of intellectual property." None of these explicitly names trade secrets, confidentiality programs or trade-secret litigation. Missing for 10: explicit trade-secret practice description, confidentiality-program advisory evidence, employee-mobility/non-compete dispute examples, trade-secret litigation matters or case studies, independent corroboration.
